item.title: Seeing Machines launches Physical AI platform for humanoid robots
item.summary: Seeing Machines has launched a “Physical AI” platform that applies the technology behind its driver-monitoring systems to robotics, as the company pushes deeper into the fast-growing market for humanoid and industrial robots. In the days since the UK Investor Magazine said Seeing Machines is ‘certainly a company to keep a close eye on’ after result […] The post Seeing Machines launches Physical AI platform for humanoid robots appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
